summary: Prompt-3 frontend verified against preview URL. Tested Quality routing/landing, all 6 Quality pages, RBAC for owner/quality/sales/crew, Monthly no-snapshot flow, Claims dialog owner-only gating, and mobile nav. Airtable-backed pages show the expected 503 'Airtable key needed' banner but render their shell (title + Refresh + testid) without crashing — this is the designed preview behaviour and is treated as PASS. Overall: all critical acceptance criteria pass. Only minor console-noise issues found.

action_items: Optional: use unique ids (project id, not date+title) as React keys for the review-row list on QualityDashboard to eliminate duplicate-key console warnings.
